scenario: The ego vehicle follows a front car through a dark urban 4-way intersection and both brake to yield to oncoming traffic passing straight through the junction.

ego.behavior: The car approaches the intersection behind a lead vehicle, brakes to avoid collision when the lead vehicle slows, then proceeds through the intersection after yielding.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight through the intersection from the opposing arm, passing in front of the ego vehicle's path.
The car leads the ego vehicle into the intersection, brakes to yield to oncoming traffic, then completes a left turn.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is positioned on a multi-lane road approaching a 4-way intersection, following a lead car in the same lane, while an oncoming adversarial vehicle approaches from the perpendicular opposing arm on the left side of the intersection.
requirements_and_restrictions: Initial distances to the intersection are defined for the ego and lead vehicle; the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has navigated through the intersection after yielding to oncoming traffic.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the following car from third-person perspective; lead car and oncoming car are adversarials. 2. Enumeration: two adversarials total. 3. Chronology: initially ego follows lead car approaching intersection; midpoint lead car brakes and ego brakes; oncoming car passes through; ending both ego and lead car complete left turn. 4. Evidence: lead car's brake lights illuminate and gap to ego shrinks; oncoming headlights traverse left-to-right across intersection.
